threshold_formula_source: docs/P1_PREREGISTRATION_V2.md, fixed before any family run executed
threshold_caveat: A policy choice derived from a measured 4-run envelope, NOT a statistical guarantee. Four repeats give a descriptive range, not a confidence interval.

superseded.previous_policy: eval score drop > 5%, latency increase > 15%, cost increase > 15%
superseded.why_superseded: Chosen by judgement, never measured. The measured same-commit accuracy spread is 1.35pp, so a 5% threshold would have been ~3.7x wider than the noise it was meant to sit above and would have missed real regressions.

gate.description: Fails CI when the metric moves further than the threshold in the bad direction.

test_suite_task_success.definition: SUCCESS episodes / episodes measured, test-suite execution accuracy

consistency_pass_pow_4.definition: Share of tasks passing in every repeat, C(c,k)/C(n,k) averaged over tasks
consistency_pass_pow_4.why_not_armed: Requires k repeats per side to evaluate. A single CI run cannot produce it, so it is a release-gate candidate rather than a per-commit gate.

mean_model_turns_per_success.definition: Model API calls per successful episode; max_steps caps this

tool_validity_rate.definition: 1 - (tool calls with arguments not matching the declared schema / tool calls)
tool_validity_rate.note: The validation-OFF ablation moved this to 0.97776 (117 malformed calls vs 16-21), roughly 12x the threshold, so this gate does detect the ablation even though accuracy does not.

estimated_cost_per_success.definition: Total estimated cost / successful episodes, from recorded tokens and the pinned price snapshot
estimated_cost_per_success.pricing_basis: Token-derived from the price snapshot stored in each run's manifest. Provider repricing must never retroactively change a historical CI verdict.

monitor.description: Reported on every run, never fails CI.

single_database_execution_accuracy.why_monitor_only: Diagnostic companion to the primary metric. Measured to credit 10.8% false positives relative to the test suite, so gating on it would gate on a known-looser signal.

external_api_p95_latency_ms.why_monitor_only: Provider-side. Measured to range 0.5s-18s within one hour, and the cause was hidden SDK retries against an exhausted quota. Gating would fail CI for someone else's incident.

termination_reason_distribution.why_monitor_only: Still churning. Across the 6 ON-to-ON pairs the mean termination-reason change count is 50.3 while mean pass/fail flips are 36.8, so ~13 reason changes per pair alter nothing about the outcome.
termination_reason_distribution.promotion_criterion: Promote once fail-to-fail reason churn is small relative to the effect sizes worth catching.

sql_execution_error_rate.why_monitor_only: Tool-call-level metric whose observed spread (0.0066) is half its own mean, so a threshold derived from it would be wider than the signal.

always_fail_regardless_of_threshold.description: Infrastructure correctness is not a tunable metric. Any non-zero value invalidates the run's quality numbers.
conditions: any RATE_LIMITED, MODEL_ERROR, or TOOL_ERROR episode
